headline: Off day behind them, Phillies open series vs. Angels
recap: The Phillies had Thursday off after closing out their series in Seattle with a 6-0 win over the Mariners on Wednesday. Bryce Harper (2-for-4, home run, double, two RBIs) and Kyle Schwarber (2-for-5, home run, double, three RBIs) provided the offense, all of it coming in the first two innings. Jesus Luzardo allowed just one hit over seven scoreless innings with nine strikeouts to beat Seattle's Bryan Woo, who was charged with six earned runs over four innings. Jhoan Duran and Tim Mayza each worked a scoreless inning in relief to close it out.
The win left Philadelphia at 74-60, holding second place in the NL East, five games behind the division-leading Atlanta Braves, and riding a one-game winning streak.
The Phillies open a three-game series at the Angels tonight, with first pitch at Angel Stadium set for 9:38 PM ET. Andrew Painter starts for Philadelphia opposite Angels left-hander Reid Detmers.
